verdict.rationale: CIPO's patents page links to "Find a licensed patent agent" (cipo-docs-18), which points to a sanctioned, licensed representative rail through which a third party can act for a company. The evidence is only a link title. Missing for 10: documentation of how an agent is appointed or authorized to act, an equivalent trademark agent or representative rail, how delegated access works in MyCIPO accounts, and any independent corroboration.
